subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable auto-cleanup and archival policy for webhook/hook sessions

question: What lifecycle policy should OpenClaw core support for hook/webhook-created sessions, and what should the default be for existing users?
rationale: The fix adds a new config/default surface and can affect stored session history and transcripts, so automation should not choose cleanup defaults or transcript-retention behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit hook cleanup policy
options.body: Add a default-preserving `hooks.sessionCleanup`-style policy with explicit on-complete, delayed, never, and transcript-retention behavior plus upgrade-safe docs/tests.

options.title: Rely on existing session maintenance
options.body: Keep hook sessions governed only by generic `session.maintenance` and document operational cleanup instead of adding a hook-specific config surface.

options.title: Defer pending session-mode decisions
options.body: Wait for the hook session-reuse and persistent-session direction to settle before adding cleanup semantics that could conflict with multi-turn hooks.

recommendation.title: Add explicit hook cleanup policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-preserving `hooks.sessionCleanup`-style policy with explicit on-complete, delayed, never, and transcript-retention behavior plus upgrade-safe docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent hook/config review history and already reviewed this issue for maintainer follow-up.
